title: The Effect of Vitamin A With and Without Zinc and Multivitamin Supplementation on Malaria Morbidity in Ghanaian Children
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to determine the effect of combining vitamin A (VA), zinc (Z) and multivitamins (MV- A, B1, B2, B6, B12, C, D and E) on malaria morbidity
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* under 5years
* will stay in the community for 10years

Exclusion Criteria:

* chronic diseases
